capabilities: Render text wrapped in --double dashes-- as blank lines in preview
Toggle fill-in-the-blank markup on selected text via ribbon icon or hotkey
Enable or disable FITB per document through frontmatter
extras: README warns that frontmatter changes may require reopening or reloading the preview window to take effect.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render inline text as blanks for fill-in-the-blank study or print materials.
summary: Markdown post-processor that renders text wrapped in double dashes as blank lines, for printable fill-in-the-blank notes.
